$shellEmptyChecks.sql: SELECT 1 FROM sync_stamps WHERE workspace_id = $1 AND origin <> 'genesis' AND author IS NOT NULL AND author NOT IN (SELECT id::text FROM actors WHERE workspace_id = $1 AND external_id = {systemExternalId})
SELECT 1 FROM domain_events WHERE workspace_id = $1 AND actor_type <> 'system' AND event_type <> 'ACTOR_CREATED'
SELECT 1 FROM actors WHERE workspace_id = $1 AND type = 'human' HAVING count(*) > 1
SELECT 1 FROM actors WHERE workspace_id = $1 AND type = 'agent' AND external_id IS DISTINCT FROM {systemExternalId}
SELECT 1 FROM content_nodes WHERE workspace_id = $1 AND node_type = 'class_tag' AND title NOT IN ('admin-only', 'person', 'workspace-config', 'meeting', 'archive', 'book', 'project', 'task', 'page')
SELECT 1 FROM spaces WHERE workspace_id = $1 AND NOT (is_default OR kind IN ('system', 'personal') OR (kind = 'shared' AND name = '受限'))
SELECT 1 FROM function_refs WHERE workspace_id = $1 AND NOT (function_id = 'tasks' AND config = '{}'::jsonb)

SELECT 1 FROM workspaces WHERE id = $1 AND NOT ((modules_off = '[]'::jsonb OR (modules_off @> '["skills","external_calendars"]'::jsonb AND modules_off <@ '["skills","external_calendars"]'::jsonb)) AND (modules_confirmed IS NULL OR modules_confirmed IN ('[]'::jsonb, '["ai"]'::jsonb)) AND home_node_id IS NULL)

SELECT 1 FROM node_tags nt WHERE NOT (nt.node_id IN (SELECT n.id FROM content_nodes n WHERE n.workspace_id = $1 AND n.source_type = 'system') AND nt.tag_id IN (SELECT n.id FROM content_nodes n WHERE n.workspace_id = $1 AND n.node_type = 'class_tag' AND n.title = 'workspace-config'))
SELECT 1 FROM content_nodes WHERE workspace_id = $1 AND {notTag} AND source_type <> 'system'

actors.neverLeaves: t.id::text IN (SELECT x.id::text FROM actors x WHERE x.type = 'session')

override.external_id: CASE WHEN t.type = 'human' THEN NULL ELSE t.external_id END

actors.note: only the System account's link (external_id) travels; a person's link to a sign-in is this node's own. A session's row is told by its key: it is never deleted and keeps its type (migration 217)

space_members.where: {space:t.space_id} AND t.space_id IN (SELECT x.id FROM spaces x WHERE x.workspace_id = $1)
space_members.neverLeaves: t.actor_id::text IN (SELECT x.id::text FROM actors x WHERE x.type = 'session')

override.parent_id: CASE WHEN t.parent_id IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM content_nodes p WHERE p.id = t.parent_id AND {row:p}) THEN t.parent_id END

content_nodes.note: a parent this reader cannot read is not named: the receiver would have no row for it

node_attributes.note: what a person, an automation or the dispatcher from a note's text wrote (migration 223); `derived` rows are worked out on each node

block_node_tags.where: t.workspace_id = $1 AND t.block_node_id IN (SELECT b.id FROM block_nodes b WHERE b.workspace_id = $1 AND {node:b.note_id}) AND {node:t.tag_id}

function_refs.where: t.workspace_id = $1 AND (t.holder_node_id IS NOT NULL AND {node:t.holder_node_id} OR t.holder_space_id IS NOT NULL AND {space:t.holder_space_id} OR t.holder_block_id IS NOT NULL AND t.holder_block_id IN (SELECT b.id FROM block_nodes b WHERE b.workspace_id = $1 AND {node:b.note_id}))

rss_subscriptions.note: the fetch state belongs to the node that fetches

rss_mutes.where: t.workspace_id = $1 AND {person:t.actor_id} AND (t.subscription_id IS NULL OR t.subscription_id IN (SELECT x.id FROM rss_subscriptions x WHERE x.workspace_id = $1 AND {space:x.space_id}))

rss_staging.where: t.workspace_id = $1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rss_seen n WHERE n.staging_id = t.id AND {person:n.actor_id}) AND t.subscription_id IN (SELECT x.id FROM rss_subscriptions x WHERE x.workspace_id = $1 AND {space:x.space_id})

rss_seen.where: {person:t.actor_id} AND t.staging_id IN (SELECT x.id FROM rss_staging x WHERE x.workspace_id = $1 AND x.subscription_id IN (SELECT r.id FROM rss_subscriptions r WHERE r.workspace_id = $1 AND {space:r.space_id}))

external_calendars.note: the address is a sealed secret, and what was last fetched is the fetching node's

review_states.where: t.workspace_id = $1 AND {person:t.actor_id} AND ((t.node_id IS NOT NULL AND {node:t.node_id}) OR (t.block_id IS NOT NULL AND t.block_id IN (SELECT b.id FROM block_nodes b WHERE b.workspace_id = $1 AND {node:b.note_id})))

ai_edit_suggestions.note: every suggestion of a note in scope, decided or not: a decision travels by bundle (migration 236); the AI session and the event that made it are this node's own

ai_edit_suggestion_items.where: t.workspace_id = $1 AND t.suggestion_id IN (SELECT g.id FROM ai_edit_suggestions g WHERE g.workspace_id = $1 AND {node:g.node_id})
